_meta: 스페인어 회화 음성 — 목소리·감정·자리 채움. 일본어앱·중국어앱 data/tts/voices.json 과 같은 짜임. 참고 음성은 VoxCPM2(설명 instruct 는 영어), 문장은 MOSS-TTS(language Spanish). PC 출력은 out/ref_es/·out/es/ (다른 언어와 섞이지 않게).
base_text: Esta tarde tengo una reunión y quiero preparar los papeles antes. ¿Te apetece cenar algo cuando termine?

am.desc: A young man in his twenties speaking clear Spanish with a slight foreign learner's care, gentle voice

af.desc: A young woman in her twenties speaking clear Spanish with a slight foreign learner's care, soft voice

lucia.desc: A Spanish woman in her early twenties, bright, fast and chatty voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

marta.desc: A Spanish woman in her mid twenties, calm, dry and slightly low voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

javi.desc: A Spanish man in his early twenties, relaxed, easygoing and warm voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

diego.desc: A Spanish man in his mid twenties, warm, honest and slightly deep voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

directora.desc: A Spanish woman in her late forties, composed, confident and precise voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

vecina.desc: A Spanish woman in her sixties, loud, warm and chatty voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

man_y.desc: A Spanish man around twenty, natural and clear voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

man_m.desc: A Spanish man in his forties, steady and calm voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

man_o.desc: A Spanish man in his seventies, aged and gentle voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

woman_y.desc: A Spanish woman around twenty, natural and clear voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

woman_m.desc: A Spanish woman in her forties, composed and kind voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

woman_o.desc: A Spanish woman in her seventies, aged and warm voice, Castilian Spanish from Madrid

announce.desc: A clear, even female announcer voice in Castilian Spanish, like a metro or store announcement

neutral.ref: Esta tarde tengo una reunión y quiero preparar los papeles antes.

polite.instruct: polite and professional, like a clerk or station staff
polite.ref: Buenos días, bienvenido. Aquí tiene su pedido, que aproveche.

stiff.instruct: very nervous and stiff, formal and overly polite
stiff.ref: Muchas gracias por recibirme. Haré todo lo posible, se lo aseguro.

cheerful.ref: ¡Hola! ¡Ya estás aquí! Hoy hace un día buenísimo, estoy de muy buen humor.

amused.ref: Jajaja, qué bueno. Vale, sigue así, que me encanta.

teasing.ref: Anda, ¿y esa cara? Venga, cuéntamelo, que no se lo digo a nadie.

excited.instruct: excited, bursting with energy, bright and loud
excited.ref: ¡Lo he conseguido! ¡Lo he dicho! ¡No me lo puedo creer, muchísimas gracias!

surprised.instruct: surprised, caught off guard, voice jumps
surprised.ref: ¿Qué? ¿En serio? Espera, ¿qué quieres decir con eso?

shout.instruct: surprised and loud, an exaggerated comic retort

tsukkomi.instruct: a quick sharp comic retort, exasperated but fond
tsukkomi.ref: Que no, que no me refiero a eso. ¿Pero tú de qué vas, hombre?

annoyed.ref: Madre mía, otra vez lo mismo. Déjalo ya, por favor.

sad.ref: Es que… estoy un poco cansado. No pasa nada, no te preocupes por mí.

worried.ref: ¿Estás bien? ¿Te encuentras mal? ¿Quieres que vayamos al médico?

flustered.ref: Eh, esto, yo, espera… es que no sé cómo decirlo…

shy.ref: Bueno… es que… a mí también me gusta. Así que… podemos ir juntos.

gentle.ref: Tranquilo, poco a poco. Estoy aquí contigo.
